_doc: Per-corner overrides for tools/place_signs.py / tools/author_signs_blend.py (W1-6 Large Arrow signs AT tight corners, Kevin 2026-10-10: 'they go AT the corner, just past the outside edge'). The rule detects corners itself; an entry here NAMES a detected corner (matched by ribbon + vertex within 30 m of the detected apex — stale after a centreline regen = refused with a WARN) and may skip it, force it, slide it along the curb, pin its base, re-aim it, or declare the arrow it must get (expect_arrow: a computed arrow that differs is a skip with a logged reason and a verify_signs FAIL, never a silent relocation). An entry speaks for the corner's FORWARD approach (increasing vertex index = the clockwise lap): on the reverse approach its arrow / expect_arrow are mirrored (the same bend driven the other way turns the other way), and keys for one approach only go in a 'fwd' or 'rev' sub-object (never mirrored), e.g. "rev": {"skip": true, "reason": "..."} drops just the anticlockwise plate; a pin key (base_xz / face_bearing_deg / slide_along_curb_m) on a corner signed both ways must sit in one of them. Ids: M<k> mainline in station order from the lap seam, each yielding M<k>-fwd and M<k>-rev since ledger 0051 (both_directions_mainline: race_acw drives the lap anticlockwise and every layout loads the one road kn5 the signs live in), connector corners <DC0|DC1|DCL|MED>-<k> (survey numbering); each connector corner yields a -fwd and a -rev sign because side streets are two-way — when the two posts would stand < 2 m apart on the built mesh they merge into ONE post carrying both plates (id without the suffix). 'ship' and 'note' are prose for Kevin, not read by the tools: the six mainline plates are the first seat test; set defaults.include_connectors=false to ship only those. 'plate' selects the sign geometry (only W1-6 is built; any other value fails the run loudly). Every other key is validated against place_signs.DEFAULTS / CORNER_KEYS at load: an unknown knob is a failure, not a silent no-op.
_p4: Ledger 0054 P4 step 1 (EXPANSION-PLAN A7 / A8). Two more kinds of entry: (1) ribbon 'north' = the stitched centre line of the north network J1 -> J5 through the junction pads (tools/expansion_lines.centre_ribbon; vertex = the stitched point index), scanned both ways with the BUILT pad decks as pavement: J2 / J3 / J4 are its tight corners (ids J<k>-fwd / J<k>-rev; unnamed ones N-c<k>). (2) per_layout: true on a MAINLINE corner = the shared plate is attempted as always and, for each race layout that drives the approach and got none, a LAYOUT PLATE is placed behind that layout's sealing wall (id <corner>-<dir>@<layout>, built into RACE_CLOSE_<TOKEN>, shipped in its closure kn5): M3 (J1) and M4 (J5). A failed-to-turn ray that runs 8 m+ down ANOTHER road before it leaves pavement is now the rule's own skip ('a through road': an arrow there would point away from a road a Free Roam driver may take). tools/verify_signs.py (m) then requires every layout, in its direction, to load a plate of every signed mainline corner or a rule / signs.json skip that applies to it.
_approved: Kevin 2026-10-10: 'placement looks right' (mainline M1-M5 + M2-2 as placed in commit ac8975d/round 2)
_0051: Kevin 2026-10-12, from the seat: 'arrow signs are only placed for one direction of driving' -> both_directions_mainline true: the same rule, run for the anticlockwise approach, adds M1-rev..M5-rev (all W1-6L); the forward plates above are unchanged. At the M2 hairpin each direction can see the other's plate across the bend; if that reads wrong, add "rev": {"skip": true, "reason": "<Kevin's words>"} to M2.

defaults._doc: see place_signs.DEFAULTS; lateral offsets = curb face 0.08 + raised walk 1.8 (1.5 connector) - 0.25 back-of-walk set-back; height 2.13 m = MUTCD 2A.15 7 ft over a sidewalk; om1_3 = the Type N-1(CA) all-yellow diamond under every arrow (CA MUTCD 2C.10 'should'); kappa_window_m / hysteresis_stations are the corner detector's curvature window and the straight run that ends a corner (place_signs.Ribbon.kappa / walk_to_straight)

M1.where: 70th St / Alvarado Rd - the lap-seam right-hander onto Alvarado
M1.note: R 12 m, ~95 deg; the ribbon width steps 27.5 -> 17 m across the seam so the Blender ROAD ray-cast is authoritative here; slide_along_curb_m / base_xz are the backstop

M2.note: R 9 m, ~180 deg hairpin: two W1-6R (first where hard turning starts at the R 60 crossing, second from the R 20 crossing at the tip, ~50 m on). Four W1-8R chevrons are the opt-in replacement for the second arrow if it reads wrong from the seat

M3.note: R 10 m, ~110 deg; 4-lane approach so lane_off is ~5 m right of the centreline - if the plate looks one lane off from the seat, slide_along_curb_m, not the formula
M3._per_layout: Ledger 0054 A7 / P4 step 1: College runs straight on into Waring, so in Free Roam the failed-to-turn ray never leaves pavement (the rule's own skip: no shared plate in the road kn5). The Speedways turn here: each race layout that drives this approach gets a LAYOUT PLATE behind its own sealing wall across the Waring opening (M3-fwd@race_cw, M3-rev@race_acw), built into its RACE_CLOSE_<TOKEN> collection and shipped in its closure kn5 — Free Roam never sees an arrow pointing into its through-road.

M4.note: R 10 m, ~110 deg; Navajo's median run ends 22 verts before the apex, no island term
M4._per_layout: Ledger 0054 A7 / P4 step 1: Navajo runs on into Jackson north, so the shared rule skips this corner (the apex is 13 m from the J5 mouth cut, mouth-flare geometry); the Speedways turn here and get M4-fwd@race_cw / M4-rev@race_acw behind their sealing wall across the Jackson-north opening, in their closure kn5s.

J2.where: Waring Rd -> Princess View Dr (junction pad J2)
J2.note: EXPANSION-PLAN A8: the turn across the J2 pad on the stitched north ribbon (R ~20 m, ~82 deg). Forward (Waring north-west -> Princess View): the failed-to-turn ray crosses the deck into Waring's south-west stub arm, the plate behind its K-rail; reverse (Princess View -> Waring, a left): the ray leaves at the pad's curb return by Mound Ave

J3.where: Princess View Dr -> Mission Gorge Rd (junction pad J3)
J3.note: EXPANSION-PLAN A8: the turn across the J3 pad (R ~17 m, ~64 deg). Forward (Princess View north -> Mission Gorge east): the ray leaves at the pad's north curb return beside the quarry drive; reverse (Mission Gorge west -> Princess View, a left): at the west curb return between the Mission Gorge west stub and the quarry drive

J4.where: Mission Gorge Rd -> Jackson Dr (junction pad J4)
J4.note: EXPANSION-PLAN A8: the turn across the J4 pad (R ~20 m, ~51 deg). Forward (Mission Gorge east -> Jackson south): the ray runs down the Mission Gorge east stub arm, the plate behind its K-rail (the foot window grows by the stub's 16 m reach); reverse (Jackson north -> Mission Gorge west, a left): the ray leaves at the pad's north-west curb return by the visitor-centre entrance

M5.note: R 11 m, ~90 deg; palm ~4-5 m away passes clearance but may sit in the sight line
